title: Canon of the Keystone Seal
summary: A canon on setting the one keystone of a stance so every other part of the guard holds and no technique can move it.

title: Treatise of Ironbound Limits
summary: A treatise on binding a foe's power with iron limits of sealed qi until he can reach no higher than the least of his techniques.

title: Manual of the Casket Seal
summary: A manual on closing a volume of space about a foe like a casket so that all within it is held motionless.

title: The Brandmark Canon
summary: A canon of deep brands of sealed qi that hold a foe fast and can be broken from within to tear him apart.

title: The Padlock Discipline
summary: A discipline of the Azure Sky halls whose last teaching is the great padlock that closes on a single foe and holds all of him.

title: The Hushbound Oath Canon
summary: A canon of the Gale oath-schools on binding a foe in hush so no word nor technique can leave him.

title: Treatise of the Oathbar
summary: A treatise on the oathbar that holds a failing breath behind it so a person lately dead may yet be called back.

title: The Holdfast Reckoning
summary: A reckoning of the holdfast that anchors the whole stance in sealed qi until nothing can shift the user.

title: The Runelock Canon
summary: A canon of runes of sealed qi cut into the foe that lock his techniques one by one and are closed by one great rune.

title: The Wardstone Discipline
summary: A discipline of wardstones of sealed qi planted in the ground that guard the user and hold fast whatever crosses them.
